import heapq

def nth_super_ugly_number(n, primes):
    heap = [p for p in primes]
    seen = set(heap)
    ugly = 1
    while len(seen) < n:
        next_ugly = heapq.heappop(heap)
        ugly = next_ugly
        for prime in primes:
            if prime * next_ugly not in seen:
                heapq.heappush(heap, prime * next_ugly)
                seen.add(prime * next_ugly)
    return ugly
